arxiv-2211-10764.title: Understanding the Bystander Effect on Toxic Twitter Conversations DOI: XXXXXXX.XXXXXXX Conference: The Web Conference(WWW) ’23; April 30–May 4, 2023; Austin, Texas Price: 15.00 ISBN: 978-1-4503-XXXX-X/18/06 CCS: Information systems Social networking sites
arxiv-2211-10764.creator: Ana Aleksandric, Mohit Singhal, Anne Groggel, Shirin Nilizadeh
arxiv-2211-10764.description: Abstract . As more users continue to embrace social media, online harassment and abusive language have become a growing concern. In this study, we explore the power of group dynamics to shape the toxicity of Twitter conversations. First, we examine how the presence of others in a conversation can potentially diffuse Twitter users’ responsibility to address a toxic direct reply.

arxiv-2307-07049.creator: Samuel Barham, Orion Weller, Michelle Yuan, Kenton Murray, Mahsa Yarmohammadi, Zhengping Jiang, Siddharth Vashishtha, Alexander Martin, Anqi Liu, Aaron Steven White, Jordan Boyd-Graber, Benjamin Van DurmeHuman Language Technology Center of ExcellenceJohns Hopkins University samuel.barham@jhuapl.edu

arxiv-2312-06686.title: Robo360: A 3D Omnispective Multi-Material Robotic Manipulation Dataset
arxiv-2312-06686.creator: Litian Liang Liuyu Bian Caiwei Xiao Jialin Zhang, Linghao Chen Isabella Liu Fanbo Xiang Zhiao Huang Hao Su
arxiv-2312-06686.description: Abstract Building robots that can automate labor-intensive tasks has long been the core motivation behind the advancements in computer vision and the robotics community. Recent interest in leveraging 3D algorithms, particularly neural fields, has led to advancements in robot perception and physical understanding in manipulation scenarios. However, the real world’s complexity poses significant challenges.

arxiv-2403-01035.title: Recent Findings from Heavy-Flavor Angular Correlation Measurements in Hadronic Collisions
arxiv-2403-01035.creator: Deepa Thomas *, Fabio Colamaria *
arxiv-2403-01035.description: Abstract The study of angular correlations of heavy-flavor particles in hadronic collisions can provide crucial insight into the heavy quark production, showering, and hadronization processes. The comparison with model predictions allows us to discriminate among different approaches for heavy quark production and hadronization, as well as different treatments of the underlying event employed by the models to reproduce correlation observables.

arxiv-2506-11791.title: SEC-bench: Automated Benchmarking of LLM Agents on Real-World Software Security Tasks
arxiv-2506-11791.creator: Hwiwon Lee Ziqi Zhang Hanxiao Lu Lingming Zhang, [] University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign Purdue University[] {hwiwonl2, ziqi24, lingming}@illinois.edu
arxiv-2506-11791.description: Abstract Rigorous security-focused evaluation of large language model (LLM) agents is imperative for establishing trust in their safe deployment throughout the software development lifecycle. However, existing benchmarks largely rely on synthetic challenges or simplified vulnerability datasets that fail to capture the complexity and ambiguity encountered by security engineers in practice.

arxiv-2511-13960.title: Classification of Aortic Shape with Topographical Pair Correlation Functions
arxiv-2511-13960.creator: Cooper Bruno, Tiago Cecchi, Joseph A. Pugar, Luka Pocivavsek, Newell Washburn
arxiv-2511-13960.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Cooper Bruno, Tiago Cecchi, Joseph A. Pugar, Luka Pocivavsek, Newell Washburn. Quantitative descriptors convert high-dimensional medical images into low-dimensional features capable of differentiating organ shapes that correlate with injury or disease progression for diagnostic purposes. An important example is aortic dissections, which can be imaged using high-resolution CT scans and for which the shape of the true and false lumens of the aorta has long been used to predict disease state and the potential for positive surgical outcomes (namely thoracic endovascular repair or TEVAR).

pmc-12457811.title: Prevalence of Disorders of Gut-Brain Interaction in Indonesian Adolescents: Has It Increased during the Coronavirus Disease Pandemic?
pmc-12457811.creator: Andy Darma, Ni Nyoman Metriani Nesa, Khadijah Rizky Sumitro, Evi Rokhayati, Budiyanto, Karolina Trigemayanti Tallo, Novi Rahayu Ariyanti, Lucia Pudyastuti Retnaningtyas, Dian Dwi Sari Mustika Febryani, Imanuel Yulius Malino, Herwina Brahmantya, Wenas Wenas, Alpha Fardah Athiyyah, Reza Gunadi Ranuh,
pmc-12457811.description: PurposeThe prevalence of disorders of gut-brain interaction (DGBI), previously known as functional gastrointestinal disorders, has increased among children and adolescents, impacting their quality of life. pmc-12734813.title: Effect of Laser Shock Peening Times on Low-Cycle Fatigue Properties and Fracture Mechanism of Additive TA15 Titanium Alloy
pmc-12734813.creator: Xu Pei, Sailan Wang, Zhaomei Xu, Zhouzhi Gu, Yuchun Peng, Pengfei Li, Georgi Kostadinov, Todor Penyashki, Mara Kandeva
pmc-12734813.description: This study investigates the effects of multiple laser shock peening (LSP) treatments on the low-cycle fatigue performance and fracture mechanisms of laser-melted, additive-manufactured Ti-6.5Al-1Mo-1V-2Zr (TA15) titanium alloy. The primary objective is to systematically evaluate how different LSP impact numbers (0, 1, and 2 impacts) enhance fatigue life and alter fracture behavior. Low-cycle fatigue life was determined via tensile-compression fatigue testing.

pmc-13053542.title: External fixation versus reverse shoulder arthroplasty for proximal humerus fractures in the elderly: a retrospective comparative study
pmc-13053542.creator: Antonio Vadalà, Cristiano Benelli, Francesco Suraci, Benedetto Carta, Giorgio Baldassari, Nicola Maffulli
pmc-13053542.description: BackgroundThe optimal management of displaced proximal humerus fractures (PHFs) in the elderly remains a subject of ongoing debate. This study aims to compare the clinical and functional outcomes of biologically driven external fixation (EF) versus functional joint replacement via reverse shoulder arthroplasty (RSA) in patients aged 65-80 years.

pmc-13231070.creator: Nina R Mehta, Matthew Mclaughlin, Israel Falade, Siyou Song, Chelsea Yim, Esther A Kim
pmc-13231070.description: Background and PurposePatients seeking gender-affirming mastectomy (GAM) frequently encounter barriers to care, including limited access to accurate and comprehensive preoperative education regarding surgical options.
